en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;On my days off, I read▼letters from Father.

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'178'10'1;$022'327'361;What do I do on weekends?▼I tidy my room all by myself.
$024'327'7;$023'327'170'10'2;$022'327'301;There are no servants here, so▼I'm forced to do the cleaning.

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'170'10'2;$022'327'301;I don't do a very good job▼though. After all, it's not▼like it's my career or anything!

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;For me, weekends are all about▼sports.
Sitting in front of the▼television, supporting▼my favorite team...

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;On my days off? I believe▼I rather enjoy fishing once▼in a while.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;I use lures though, because I▼can't imagine handling those▼disgusting earthworm creatures.

en: $024'327'4;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'383;Of course, those slimy fish▼aren't much more pleasant▼to handle themselves.

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;Now don't tell anyone,▼but I sometimes go to▼school on weekends.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;I like to lend my teachers▼a helping hand when I can.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;That's why they like me so▼much, and that's how I'll get▼better grades than you.

en: $024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;But that's a secret and will▼remain a secret. Got that?
$024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;If you tell anyone, I'll spread▼nasty rumors about you.

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;Well, that was the plan...▼As it turns out, she's not▼too fond of creepy crawlies.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;In the evenings, I rather▼enjoy a bit of stargazing.
$024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;If you're patient enough,▼you'll most likely see▼a shooting star or two.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;My friends tell me their▼dreams in the daytime...
and then I wish upon the stars▼for them at night.

en: $024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;Of course, there's a small▼charge for this service...▼How about it, $500;?
vi: $024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;Tất nhiên có thu phí▼dịch vụ chút đỉnh...▼Sao nào, $500;?

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;My next day off? I'm planning▼on staying home and watching▼a bit of television.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Sometimes one just needs▼to relax. A hardworking brain▼deserves a break now and again.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Não làm việc chăm chỉ▼thì cũng phải được▼nghỉ ngơi chứ!

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'170'10'2;$022'327'301;Oh, I really do need to clean▼the bathroom on my next day▼off. It's just filthy.
vi: $024'327'7;$023'327'170'10'2;$022'327'301;Ngày nghỉ tới phải▼cọ nhà tắm mới được.▼Bẩn hết biết!

en: $024'327'4;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'383;It sure would be nice▼to have some help...
$024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;Not for free, of course.▼I'll let you see my school▼work as compensation.
vi: $024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;Không để cậu làm không đâu.▼Tớ cho cậu xem▼bài tập của tớ!

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;On my next day off, I'll be▼getting the book I asked for.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Ngày nghỉ tới, tớ sẽ▼nhận quyển sách▼đã đặt trước!

en: $024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;I bet I'm the only one in this▼town who can get my hands on▼books before they go on sale.

en: $024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;Would you like to see it?▼I'll show you if you want.▼But only the first page...
vi: $024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;Muốn xem à?▼Được thôi, nhưng▼chỉ trang đầu nhé!

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;I went fishing the other day.▼You know, just to pass the time.
vi: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;Hôm nọ tớ đi câu,▼chỉ để giết thời gian.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Suddenly, I felt a tug on the▼line. Wonderful, I thought, it's▼a huge fish! So I reeled it in.

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'170'10'2;$022'327'301;Unfortunately, it wasn't a fish▼at all. It was some trash I'd▼thrown in the river earlier.

en: $024'327'4;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'383;I must have upset the river▼spirits. Of course, I apologized▼straight away...

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;Well, I hadn't been at▼the school for very▼long when it happened.

en: $024'327'5;$023'327'170'10'1;$022'327'301;I was desperate for the▼toilet and rushed down▼the corridor to find it.

en: $024'327'5;$023'327'175'8'1;$022'327'342;Upon entering, I suddenly▼found myself being assaulted▼by some unfamiliar girl.

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'177'10'1;It seems it was the　girls'▼toilet I'd entered...

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;So I was eating soup at▼a restaurant one day when▼my nose started running.
vi: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;Có lần tớ đang ăn súp▼ở nhà hàng thì▼tự dưng sổ mũi.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Well well well, I thought, no▼need bothering with tissues. Who▼would even notice my sniffling?

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Boy, it's tough being so smart.▼The other day, some girl asked▼me for help with her studies.

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;Every time I answered one of▼her questions, another followed,▼harder than the one before.

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'177'10'1;I must say...I was a bit▼embarrassed when I couldn't▼come up with all the answers.

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;I received a letter from▼Father. He asked if I've▼made any friends.

en: $024'327'5;$023'327'175'8'1;$022'327'342;Well, he somehow got the▼impression that I was all▼alone. So what did he do next?

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'177'10'1;He wrote a letter to▼the $000'3;dormitory manager$000'1;,▼$000'3;Reginald$000'1;!
$024'327'7;$023'327'170'10'2;$022'327'301;Why must he treat me▼like such a child?
$024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;I can't believe it. I think▼I skipped a check box on the▼answer sheet in that last test.

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;I was running to school when▼I tripped and fell and scraped▼my knees on the pavement.

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;When handing in essay papers,▼timing is everything.

vi: $024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;Nên tớ luôn nhét▼bài mình vào▼chính giữa chồng giấy!

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;So I went bowling the other day,▼but couldn't manage to throw▼the ball in a straight line.

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'170'10'2;$022'327'301;No matter how hard I tried,▼it always ended up curving▼into the gutter.

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'178'10'1;$022'327'361;You don't think that it's▼a reflection of my life,▼do you?

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;It's best to choose friends▼with similar personalities,▼friends who see your true self.

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'170'10'2;$022'327'301;Talking with those kinds of▼easily confused individuals▼can be quite exhausting.

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;And you may think I'm conceited▼or thoughtless for saying that,▼but I can't help who I am.

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;Apparently I used to say things▼that occasionally upset people.

en: $024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;Nowadays though, I try to think▼before opening my mouth.

en: $024'327'4;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'383;And can you believe it?▼People now tell me that▼I never open up to them.
